text: Start low and work yourself up slowly to the full dosage, which is usually 4.5 milligrams. You will most likely have some sleep disturbance and realistic dreaming when you start. This will diminish with time. It can be lessened or eliminated by taking the LDN in the morning instead of the evening. LDN is usually taken at night, but does not have to be. Also, as with other treatments, it can increase or exacerbate inflammation or symptoms in the beginning. That's why I say start low and increase slowly.
